cd /app && cat > prep.py <<'EOF'
import pandas as pd, re, html

pat = re.compile(r"([.!?,/()'\";:])")
def norm(t):
    t = html.unescape(t).replace("\\n"," ").replace("\\\"",'"').replace("\n"," ")
    t = t.lower()
    t = pat.sub(r" \1 ", t)
    return re.sub(r"\s+"," ",t).strip()

for split,fn in [("train","data/train-00000-of-00001.parquet"),("test","data/test-00000-of-00001.parquet")]:
    d = pd.read_parquet(fn)
    with open(f"{split}.txt","w") as f:
        for l,t in zip(d.label.values, d.text.values):
            f.write(f"__label__{l} {norm(t)}\n")
    print(split, len(d))
EOF
python3 prep.py && wc -l train.txt test.txt && head -c 300 train.txt
